text:
ria: Quick design check — dashboard card rows feel cramped on tablet widths, especially when toasts appear. thoughts?

sam: I noticed that too on staging. the horizontal gutters collapse and buttons look squished.

dana: Agree. looks particularly bad when a toast stacks over the primary CTA. hard to scan.

alex: Can we nudge the grid gap token up one step at 768-1024px breakpoints? currently using `token-gap-sm` -> maybe `token-gap-md`?

ria: @alex yeah that was my thought. But concerned about vertical rhythm with modals that anchor to card edges.

sam: If we increase horizontal gap we should reduce top/bottom padding slightly to keep card densities similar. ie keep overall footprint but avoid cramped buttons.

ria: Example CSS snippet I tried:
```css
@media (min-width: 768px) and (max-width: 1024px) {
  --card-gap: var(--token-gap-md);
  --card-vertical-padding: calc(var(--token-space-sm) - 2px);
}
```

dana: That looks reasonable. did you test with toasts? sometimes toast shadow + z-index makes it read like it's clipping.

ria: Tested with toast variant `info/compact` and `success/stacked`. When gap increased, toast sits more comfortably without covering the CTA. But alignment with table rows in the dashboard list view shifts.

alex: Could we make toast alignment prefer the card’s inner-padding instead of absolute right? eg anchor x-offset = card padding + 8px. That would make toasts align with content instead of edge.

sam: I worry about consistency across pages. We have other places that assume right-aligned to viewport. adding per-card offsets could create visual inconsistency.

dana: Maybe a compromise: toast offset only inside dense list/card contexts. Add `toast--contextual` class. default behavior unchanged.

ria: I like that. then it's an opt-in pattern for components that manage their own toasts. Add guidance in the tokens page.

alex: Accessibility nit: when we increase horizontal gap, the focus ring on keyboard nav feels further from the label. Might need to increase hit target or visually tighten focus outline.

sam: Good call. We should keep 44px min tap target. So if padding shrinks we must ensure buttons remain >=44px.

ria: I'll update the Figma file with the new token variant and a note: "tablet: use token-gap-md; ensure button min-height 44px; use toast--contextual for card-level toasts."

dana: Can you add a quick screenshot of the before/after? small annotated diff would be helpful for product review. :eyes:

ria: Uploaded to the thread: https://redwood.design/figma/frames/173999 — compare frames 02/03

alex: Small copy tweak request for toast text when it overlaps action: change "Saved" -> "Saved to dashboard" in compact variant so it's less ambiguous.

sam: +1. also prefer sentence case for toasts.

ria: noted. making copy change and adding to the toast copy table in docs.

design-bot: Deploy preview: staging-redwood/ux/173999 updated — visual diff shows 2 changed components (Card, Toast).

ria: Thanks — anyone object to rolling this to canary?

sam: no objections from me.

alex: go for it, once we ensure min tap targets.

dana: fine, will add accessibility checklist item to the PR: verify focus ring distance and 44px targets.

ria: Great. I'll open the PR and tag @sam @dana for review. PR title: "tablet: increase card gap token; contextual toasts; toast copy tweak"

sam: thanks — I'll review tomorrow morning.

alex: ping me if there are layout regressions on narrow desktop.

ria: will do. thanks team :thumbsup:
